video_title: Shams details the latest with the Knicks pausing extensions with KAT and Josh Hart 🏀 | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks aim to eliminate distractions by pausing contract extension talks
quotes.excerpt: This is the Knicks attempting to essentially eliminate the distraction, eliminate the growing cloud around the team
quotes.quote: This is the Knicks attempting to essentially eliminate the distraction, eliminate the growing cloud around the team that has come from the fact that there is no extension for Karl-Anthony Towns or Josh Hart yet and trying to bring the focus back to basketball. But now officially, both of these sides are fully divided on this issue. Karl-Anthony Towns wants a contract extension, the Knicks have now stated and fully shut the door that there won't be an extension.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' latest offer to Karl-Anthony Towns was significantly below his max
quotes.excerpt: Their latest offer to Karl-Anthony Towns was four years about $200 million, that's $76 million less than his max
quotes.quote: Negotiations have been idle between the Knicks and Karl-Anthony Towns for a while now. Their latest offer to Karl-Anthony Towns was four years about $200 million, that's $76 million less than his max. My understanding is Karl-Anthony Towns would be willing to take tens of millions of dollars less than that max number, but he feels that current offer is just too steep, too extreme of a pay cut to take.

quotes.speaker: Malika Andrews
quotes.summary_phrase: James Dolan's directive to avoid the second apron impacts contract talks
quotes.excerpt: We are at this point because James Dolan said we don't want to go into the second apron

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson and OG Anunoby's contract situations complicate the Knicks' cap
quotes.excerpt: Josh Hart has to be taken care of. There's a team option there. OG Anunoby's going to be up
quotes.quote: It's hard because Josh Hart has to be taken care of. There's a team option there. OG Anunoby's going to be up next year. That's something. Jalen Brunson, you know he's going to receive every penny of every max deal that he can get from them. I'm sure there's a way that it could be done. It's due to the Knicks have the appetite to want to do that.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Contract disputes can create locker room distractions for the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: If you have other guys that are disgruntled and want their money, this can deter or really distract
quotes.quote: It depends on the personnel. Karl-Anthony Towns is not known to be a guy to be disruptive, but if you have other guys that are disgruntled and want their money, this can deter or really distract the whole season of a team and a group and can divide the group. But I see both sides of it. The fan in me loves to see better free agency, so I want to see everybody wait till free agency.
